decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority (M.B/HN/156.1; Received 26 August 2012), or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for hot food takeaway (A5) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 08:00-23:00 Monday- Saturday, and 09:00-20:00 Sundays, Public and Bank Holidays

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for hot food takeaway (A5) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 08:00-23:00 Monday- Saturday, and 09:00-20:00 Sundays, Public and Bank Holidays.
Reason. To protect neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV.B.1.1 New development and ENV.P.1.5 Noise pollution
The use shall not commence until a scheme for the control of noise, fumes and odours (which shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-carbon and carbon filter), including full details of the technical specification, size, appearance and position of the proposed extract flue have been has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.  The noise generated by the ventilation system when operating at its maximum level shall be 10dB(A) below existing background noise levels and shall be mounted on anti-vibration mountings.

The scheme shall be fully implemented before the premises open to customers.
Note: The scheme shall be in accordance with the 'Guidance on Control of Odour and Noise from Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Systems, January 2005' from Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs.
description: Change of use of the premises from office use to takeaway use
